subject: Quick note on Fabwell Engineering's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Fabwell Engineering stood out.

Stainless and mild steel fabrications from the Wrexham Industrial Estate since 1979 - and fabwelleng.co.uk still says Fabweb Enginering coveres, lists 20 Years Fabrication Experience, and keeps a live Fax on the contact page. Decades of coded welding; a homepage that undercuts the craft.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
